description: GraphQL federation query planner fails to inject required prerequisite fields across subgraphs, causing resolution failures.
spec_notes: FederationQueryPlanner.plan_query must inject field.required_fields into upstream service sub-queries.

repo_files.schema.py:
"""GraphQL federation subgraph schema definitions."""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Dict, List


@dataclass
class SubgraphField:
    name: str
    service_name: str
    required_fields: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)

tests.test_federation_planner.py:
from schema import SubgraphField
from service_registry import FederationRegistry
from planner import FederationQueryPlanner


def test_federated_dependency_injection():
    reg = FederationRegistry()
    # User service provides id, username
    reg.register_field(SubgraphField("id", "users_service"))
    reg.register_field(SubgraphField("username", "users_service"))
    # Reviews service provides rating, but requires id
    reg.register_field(SubgraphField("rating", "reviews_service", required_fields=["id"]))
    planner = FederationQueryPlanner(reg)
    # Querying rating on reviews service must inject id fetch in users_service!
    plan = planner.plan_query(["rating"])
    svc_map = {step.service: step.requested_fields for step in plan}
    assert "reviews_service" in svc_map
    assert svc_map["reviews_service"] == ["rating"]
    assert "users_service" in svc_map
    assert "id" in svc_map["users_service"]


def test_simple_single_service_query():
    reg = FederationRegistry()
    reg.register_field(SubgraphField("title", "products_service"))
    planner = FederationQueryPlanner(reg)
    plan = planner.plan_query(["title"])
    assert len(plan) == 1
    assert plan[0].service == "products_service"
    assert plan[0].requested_fields == ["title"]
